correctness.rationale: For n>=2, rotation shifts i and n-i have the same Hamming distance. On each of gcd(n,i)=g position cycles of length L=n/g, rotational distance two means exactly one cycle with one contiguous cyclic nonempty run of 1s (two transitions) and other cycles constant, yielding F_i=n(1+y^L)^(g-1) sum_(a=1..L-1)y^a. Gabrić Lemma14 identifies overlap with any smaller positive shift by one-error periodic templates. When i does not divide n, the earlier shift g produces B_i=n(y+y^(L-1))(1+y^L)^(g-1), with no ambiguity since L>=3. When i divides n, nonprimitive length-i templates have Möbius polynomial P_i(x)=-sum_(d|i,d>1)mu(d)(1+x^d)^(i/d); counting one-coordinate flips gives B_i=(n/i)[(y^(L-1)-y^(L+1))P_i'(y^L)+i*y*P_i(y^L)]. At L=2 the proof rules out two nonprimitive backgrounds Hamming distance one; so earliest-shift F_i-B_i are disjoint. Proper powers cannot have positive conjugate distance two, hence each counted necklace has n representatives. For odd prime p, F_i=p sum_(a=1..p-1)y^a and corrections remove endpoints for i>=2, giving p at weights 1,p-1 and p(p-1)/2 at each interior weight 2..p-2. Direct independent enumeration of all 2^n words n=2..14 matched each polynomial and content; no finite test was treated as all-n proof.
